teyvatcartographia.settings.title: Map settings
Demon, quest, star, meat, flower, pickaxe and hook pins on the world map. Where else they show (the minimap, the marker and the beam in the world): All settings > Pins.
World spawn and last death on the world map. Where else they show (the minimap, the marker and the beam in the world): All settings > Pins.
teyvatcartographia.settings.path.tooltip: The path to a tracked custom or system pin on the world map. All settings set it for each kind separately.
teyvatcartographia.settings.stones.toolt: The stones of Waystones on the world map. Where else they show (the minimap, the marker and the beam in the world): All settings > Compatibility > Waystones.
The path to a tracked stone of Waystones on the world map. Where else it shows: All settings > Compatibility > Waystones.
teyvatcartographia.settings.plants.toolt: Plants colour their spot on the map. Which plants: All settings > Map. Places already mapped change when you pass by again.
teyvatcartographia.config.title: Teyvat Cartographia settings
teyvatcartographia.config.theme.tooltip: Colours, icons and Fog of War of the map, the minimap and the menus. Other themes come with their resource packs.
Square or round minimap, whatever the look of the rest of the interface.
teyvatcartographia.config.interface_styl: Rectangular: flat panels, buttons and tiles with square corners. Rounded: circles, capsules and rounded corners.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_zoom.toolt: Zoom the world map opens with.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_labels.too: Biome names on the world map.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_grid.toolt: Chunk and region borders on the world map: regions from zoom 1/8, chunks from 2.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_enable: Show the minimap. The Show/hide minimap key (N at first) switches it too.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_zoom.t: Minimap zoom, from 1/32 to 32; the Zoom minimap in and out keys (= and - at first) change it too. The world map keeps a zoom of its own.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_orient: North up: the map stays still. Rotate with view: the map turns with you and shows E, S and W too.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_rate.t: Redraws per second while you move. Lower gives more FPS.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_radius: How large the minimap is, in interface units from its centre to its edge; at most what the screen holds with the lines under it.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_offset: Distance from the side of the screen.
Distance from the top or bottom of the screen.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_opacit: How opaque the minimap is, with its frame, its pins and the lines under it.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_paddin: Gap between the frame and the map inside it.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_fade_w: How much of the radius fades out towards the frame. 0%: a sharp edge.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_fade_s: How transparent the very edge of the map gets. 100%: it fades out completely, 0%: no fading.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_info_g: Distance from the minimap to the lines under it (coordinates, biome, clock and day) and between those lines.
Players, mobs and other entities around you as dots on the maps, as far as the game knows of them.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_range.to: How far around you entities show on the radar, in chunks. On a server only as far as it sends them (mobs: about 8 chunks).
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_height.t: Entities well above or below you are fainter, with a small arrow up or down.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_server_m: On a server the radar shows only other players unless this is on. A server can forbid the radar, as for Xaero's Minimap.
Other players in the colour of their team. Point at one on the world map to see the name.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_player_l: Players as arrows in the colour of their team, or as the heads of their skins framed in that colour (white without a team).
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_mob_look: Mobs as dots in the colour of their kind, or as the faces of their textures framed in that colour. Mobs of other mods stay dots.
Zombies, skeletons, creepers and every other mob that attacks you, as red dots.
Animals, golems and other mobs that do not attack, as white dots.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_villager: Villagers and wandering traders as yellow dots.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_pets.too: Wolves, cats, horses and other animals you tamed, as turquoise dots.
teyvatcartographia.config.radar_other.to: Boats, minecarts and items on the ground, as lavender dots.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_text_s: Size of the text under and on the minimap, in whole screen pixels so it stays sharp. Auto: one step below the interface.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_pill_o: How opaque the background of the lines under the minimap is. 0%: text only.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_time.t: A clock under the minimap: game time, your computer's time, or both side by side (game time on the left).
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_time_f: How the clock writes the time: 24-hour (14:35), 12-hour (2:35) or with AM/PM (2:35 PM). Only while the clock is on.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_day.to: The day of the world under the minimap, together with the game time when the clock shows it.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.custom.to: Your own pins, a box for each place: world map, minimap, the marker over a tracked one, its beam (with the marker).
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.interacti: The stones of Waystones, a box for each place: world map, minimap, the marker over a tracked one, its beam.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.system.to: World spawn and last death, a box for each place: world map, minimap, the marker over a tracked one, its beam.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.custom.to: The path to a tracked custom pin, a box for each place: the world map, the minimap, the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.interacti: The path to a tracked stone of Waystones, a box for each place: the world map, the minimap, the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.system.to: The path to a tracked system pin, a box for each place: the world map, the minimap, the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path_route.too: By land: round deep water, swimming only where it is narrow. By water: by boat. By air: a straight line, for elytra.
teyvatcartographia.config.marker_show_fo: How long the marker, beam and stars show after you track a pin or press the key to show it again. Always: they never fade.
teyvatcartographia.config.detail.tooltip: Low: flat colours. Medium: shaded slopes. High: also contour lines.
teyvatcartographia.config.caves.tooltip: Caves mapped by layers while you are underground: on the world map (its layer buttons) and on the minimap.
teyvatcartographia.config.player_cone.to: The cone of light the player arrow looks along and the glow under it, on the world map and on the minimap. Off: the arrow alone.
teyvatcartographia.config.far_land.toolt: Single player: the outline of unexplored land, faint under the Fog of War on both maps, up to the world border.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_outline.to: A round turquoise line glowing into the Fog of War, not chunk steps. Animated, it swells and draws back like water.
teyvatcartographia.config.world_border.t: The world border as a red line on both maps, over the Fog of War too. All beyond it is darker.
teyvatcartographia.config.plants.tooltip: Plants colour their spot on the map. The arrow opens their list: one switched off shows the ground under it.
teyvatcartographia.config.scan_radius.to: How far around you the map is drawn, in chunks.
teyvatcartographia.config.chunks_per_tic: More fills the map faster but costs more FPS.
teyvatcartographia.config.max_tiles.tool: Map regions kept in memory. More uses more RAM.
teyvatcartographia.config.water_depth.to: How much deeper water gets darker. 0%: all water the same colour.
How much of the ground shows through shallow water, less the deeper it is. 0%: off.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.nether_: Unexplored parts of The Nether are smoke with embers. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.end_fog: Unexplored parts of The End are a starry void with a nebula, and the islands cast a shadow on it. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.aether_: Unexplored parts of The Aether are a sea of clouds, and the islands cast a shadow on it. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_fo: Unexplored parts of The Sift are a haze in the colours of its ichor. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.preview.no_wor: Open them in a world to see it.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_ic: The ichor shimmers on the map in its own colours. Off: its texture's average colour. Mapped places change on your next visit.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_sn: Ichor snow shimmers on the map in its own colours. Off: its texture's average colour. Mapped places change on your next visit.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_t: The custom pin type the imported waypoints get.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_h: Import the waypoints that are switched off in Xaero's Map too.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_d: Import Xaero's Map death points too, named "Death point".
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_m: Brings the Overworld's surface explored with Xaero's Map onto this map; what is on it stays. In a world only.
teyvatcartographia.xaero_import.title: Explored map from Xaero's Map
teyvatcartographia.xaero_import.none: Xaero's Map has no map of this dimension here.
teyvatcartographia.xaero_import.keeps: Places already on this map stay as they are.
teyvatcartographia.xaero_import.done: Done: %s chunks added, broken regions skipped: %s
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sable_r: Ships and other structures of Sable on the radar, drawn from their own blocks and turned as they sail; far out an icon.
